program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (16.0, 11.0, 20.0),     # diff-pair efficiency (also lowers Vgs -> tail headroom)
    "L_in":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "gmid_p":  (10.0, 7.0, 13.0),      # PMOS mirror load + CS stage (same gm/Id, L -> no systematic offset)
    "L_p":     (0.6, 0.4, 1.2),
    "gmid_n":  (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),      # NMOS bias/tail/sink mirrors
    "L_n":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Itail":   (40e-6, 20e-6, 70e-6),
    "I7":      (140e-6, 80e-6, 200e-6),
    "Cc":      (1.3e-12, 0.6e-12, 2.5e-12),
    "kRz":     (1.6, 0.8, 3.0),        # Rz = kRz / gm6
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    It, I7 = p["Itail"], p["I7"]

    # first stage: NMOS diff pair, PMOS mirror load
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], It / 2, vds=0.6, vsb=0.2)
    vsrc = vcm - m1.vgs
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], It / 2, vds=0.7)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], It / 2, vds=m3.vgs)   # diode: vds = vgs
    # tail + bias mirrors (same gm/Id, L as reference diode)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["L_n"], It, vds=max(vsrc, 0.15))
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["L_n"], iref, vds=mt.vgs)
    # second stage: PMOS CS (same gm/Id, L as load -> Vgs match), NMOS sink
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], I7, vds=0.9)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["L_n"], I7, vds=0.9)

    Cc = p["Cc"]
    Rz = p["kRz"] / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB",  "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT",  "tail",  "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1",  "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2",  "y", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3",  "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4",  "y", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6",  "vout", "y", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7",  "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "vout", "nc", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "nc", "y", Cc)

    # predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m6.cgg
    Cout = CL + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (C1 * Cc + C1 * Cout + Cc * Cout))
    f_mirror = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    fz = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * max(Rz - 1.0 / m6.gm, 1e-3))   # LHP zero when Rz > 1/gm6
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / f_mirror)) \
         + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fz)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3))
    power = 1.98 * (iref + It + I7)
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (CL + Cc))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power, "slew": slew}

events.topology: Two-stage Miller (NMOS-input 5T first stage + PMOS CS second stage, Rz-Cc compensation)
